title: Payment service database connection timeout
description: The payment API intermittently timed out while opening database connections during normal traffic. Requests took longer than usual and some payments could not be completed.
rootCause: The database connection pool was too small for the normal number of concurrent payment requests.
resolution: Increased the connection pool from 10 to 30 after checking database capacity, then restarted the payment workers. Request timeouts stopped.

title: Login API returned unauthorized errors
description: Users with valid accounts were unexpectedly logged out and received HTTP 401 responses when calling the login-protected API.
rootCause: The access-token refresh flow did not handle expired refresh tokens correctly.
resolution: Corrected refresh-token validation and added a safe re-authentication path when a refresh token expires.

title: Payment database timeout continued under peak load
description: The payment service showed database connection timeouts again during a traffic spike, even after the connection pool size was increased.
rootCause: Long-running queries and saturated database connections were consuming the available connection capacity.
resolution: Tried increasing the connection pool again without checking database capacity. The database became more overloaded and the timeout problem continued; this attempted fix failed.

title: User profile API response became slow
description: The user profile endpoint took several seconds to return for users with large activity histories.
rootCause: A frequently used query filtered by user ID without a suitable database index.
resolution: Added and verified an index on the user ID column, then checked query execution time. The endpoint returned to its normal response time.

title: Notification emails were not being delivered
description: The notification service accepted email jobs, but messages remained queued and were not delivered.
rootCause: The SMTP host and port in the service configuration did not match the email provider settings.
resolution: Updated the SMTP host and port, verified the credentials, and sent a test email successfully.

title: Inventory service ran out of memory
description: The inventory service repeatedly restarted after memory usage increased during a batch stock update.
rootCause: A memory leak in the batch-processing path caused memory usage to grow over time.
resolution: Restarted the service as a quick workaround. Memory usage dropped briefly, but the leak remained and the service failed again. The restart did not resolve the root cause.

title: Order API returned internal server errors
description: Some order submissions failed with HTTP 500 when optional fields were missing or contained unexpected values.
rootCause: The API did not validate incoming request fields before processing them, and unexpected values caused unhandled exceptions.
resolution: Added request validation and handled invalid input with clear client error responses instead of internal server errors.

title: Database rejected new inventory connections
description: The inventory service received too-many-connections errors after several background jobs ran at the same time.
rootCause: Database connections were not consistently released after background jobs completed.
resolution: Fixed connection cleanup in the job handlers and added connection timeouts so unused connections were released.

title: Payment database timeout during heavy traffic
description: Payment requests timed out during a high-traffic period. Database monitoring showed slow repeated queries and high connection utilisation.
rootCause: Repeated expensive queries increased database load and left too little capacity for new payment requests.
resolution: Optimised the repeated queries, checked database capacity, and tuned the connection pool within the supported limit. Payment requests recovered.

title: Document upload requests were rejected
description: Users could not upload larger supporting documents because the API rejected requests that exceeded its configured request-size limit.
rootCause: The configured maximum upload size was lower than the application's approved document-size requirement.
resolution: Updated the request-size limit to the approved value and verified uploads at the new limit.
